description: Send a state-changing contract call — for example mint — and return once it has succeeded on chain. The call is simulated first: if it would revert, the revert reason is returned and nothing is sent. Give the ABI as artifactPath (the file deploy_contract took) or as abi, which can be just the function's signature, e.g. ["function mint() returns (uint256)"] — exactly one of the two. It calls only a contract this server deployed in this session (with deploy_contract, on the same chain) or one whose address AVAKIT_WRITE_ALLOWLIST lists in the server's environment (AVAKIT_WRITE_ALLOWLIST=* allows any), and sends at most AVAKIT_MAX_VALUE AVAX with a call (0.1 when it is not set). Any other call is refused before anything is signed, and only the person running the server can change either variable. On the Fuji testnet (the default) no key is needed: when AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY is not set, the server signs with a temporary session test wallet that exists only in its memory, works on Fuji only, and is funded from the AvaKit faucet when it cannot pay. Mainnet (c-chain) needs all three of: your own key in AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY, confirm:true in this call AND AVAKIT_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 in the server's environment, which only the person running the server can set — without it a mainnet call is refused even with confirm:true. The result says which wallet signed. To read state use read_chain.

abi.description: Instead of artifactPath: the JSON ABI, or signatures such as ["function mint() returns (uint256)"].

address.description: The contract's address, e.g. the one deploy_contract returned: a contract this server deployed in this session, or one AVAKIT_WRITE_ALLOWLIST lists.

args.description: The function's arguments, in order. Pass large integers as decimal strings.

artifactPath.description: Path to the contract's artifact file, relative to the server's working directory: one of the `artifacts` scaffold_app returned (e.g. my-app/lib/nft-artifact.ts), or a Foundry/Hardhat JSON artifact with abi and bytecode. Must be inside the working directory.

confirm.description: Required on mainnet (c-chain), together with AVAKIT_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 in the server environment. Not needed on Fuji.

functionName.description: The function to call, e.g. "mint". To pick between overloads, the full signature, e.g. "safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256)".

value.description: Wei to send with a payable call (decimal string). Only with your own key (AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY) on Fuji, and at most AVAKIT_MAX_VALUE AVAX (0.1 unless the server sets it): the session test wallet never sends value, and value is refused on mainnet.

title: Call a contract (state-changing)
